known.summary: archive accepts a pull-request closer only when it also appears in `closedByPullRequestsReferences(excludeUserLinked: true)`, but GitHub lists a pull request opened from a `gh issue develop` linked branch as user-linked, so that connection is empty for the lifecycle's own pull requests and archive refuses every legitimately merged plan.
The plan-cli harness now kills every CLI run after 10 seconds (`timeout: 10_000`), so on a slow or loaded runner a correct command is killed and the gate fails without a defect.
